versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Product Feature Patent Finder.
- Input a product feature description to automatically research key technical dimensions, retrieve and score relevant patents, and generate a self-contained, interactive HTML report.
- Report includes product overview, numbered technical breakdown (T1–TN), public product information summary, and product images where available.
- Patent list provides correlation scores (0–10), explanations, and direct mapping to technical dimensions with interactive filtering.
- Allows filters by assignee, jurisdiction, date range, and patent result count.
- Generates HTML using built-in CSS/JS, with chunked file writing for large reports.
- Requires configuration of PatSnap’s MCP tools for real-time patent search; otherwise, outputs only the analysis framework.
